propositions: A ticket directory with no CREATE or SNAPSHOT event causes the plan-relation reducer to fail, surfacing as an INDETERMINATE verdict on unrelated tickets in the same relation graph.
Event-less directories are not tracked by git and are invisible to git status, so the artifact persists in local clones and cannot be removed by pulling shared history.
The reducer error names the broken orphan ticket, not the ticket being reviewed, creating a wrong-direction debugging signal.
The plan-relation reducer must tolerate event-less ticket directories by skipping them with a warning rather than failing the entire snapshot.
The writer creates ticket directories before emitting events (via os.makedirs in event_append._prepare_event), and process death within the staging window leaves orphan empty directories.
